text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... It doesn't look like it's 
going to stop anytime soon...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
When I got all fired up to do my best, it 
went like 'heave, ho, pbbbt~'...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I didn't bump into anything today, 
though... Why am I getting a nosebleed...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps fatigue has built up from running 
in consecutive races. It looks like we'll 
need to reconsider our upcoming schedule."
